title: Measures to Ensure Passengers Do Not Overstay in Transit Area of Changi Airport
what_it_is: Measures to Ensure Passengers Do Not Overstay in Transit Area of Changi Airport

sections.label: Transit area stay rules
sections.summary: Passengers may stay in the transit area only for a temporary layover, with agencies patrolling and checking valid reasons.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Passengers are allowed to stay within the transit area of the airport only if it is a temporary layover prior to a planned departure.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Our security agencies conduct regular patrols and look out for people who may not have a valid reason to be in the transit area.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: For example, transit lounge operators will report to the Airport Police when travellers entering the lounge do not have a valid air ticket for a departing flight.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Lastly, the Airport Police works with the Immigration and Checkpoints Authority (ICA) to identify, through ICA's records, persons who may have been in the transit area without a valid reason.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Indeed, the transit passengers are allowed to stay in the transit area up to 72 hours to wait for their connecting flights.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: So, passengers departing from Singapore will be allowed entry into the transit area if their flight is departing within the next 24 hours.

sections.label: Tracking stranded transit passengers
sections.summary: Authorities work with airlines and Airport Police and are aware of situations where flights are cancelled or postponed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Dennis Tan Lip Fong (Hougang)
sentences.text: So, does the ICA or the Airport Police track passengers who were, for example, scheduled to take a flight within the next 24 hours, and for some unforeseeable reasons, their flight was cancelled or postponed, and it goes beyond the 72 hours, is there a special mechanism to track such passengers?

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: We work very closely with the airline, the Airport Police and the community within the airport.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: So, I want to assure Members that we are aware of such situations if they arise and we will also work with the passengers to assure them that they can go to various places and not to worry about it.
